basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 25-year-old Pokémon enthusiast from Düsseldorf, Germany. I recently got into shiny hunting and I'm loving every moment of it. When I'm not busy hunting for rare Pokémon, I work as a junior graphic designer at a small creative agency. I enjoy playing video games, particularly titles from the Pokémon franchise, and watching football matches featuring Bayer 04 Leverkusen. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 11 PM CET. I love connecting with fellow gamers and expanding my Friend Safari list!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in both graphic design and video games. I studied graphic design at a local university in Düsseldorf and have been self-teaching myself various design software since my teenage years. My passion for Pokémon started at a young age, and it has only grown with each new game release.
